svg.aria-label: Bradley-Terry Reward Model Architecture and Reward Hacking Mitigation via LCB Ensembles
svg.text: Reward Model Architecture & Goodhart's Law Mitigation (ORM vs. PRM & LCB Ensembles)
Margin-centered Bradley-Terry loss, step-level process supervision, and conservative Lower-Confidence-Bound reward gating
A. Bradley-Terry ORM vs. Step-Level Process RM (PRM)
1. Outcome Reward Model (ORM): Sequence-Level Scalar Score
Backbone: Frozen/LoRA SFT Transformer (w_vocab replaced by w_r in R^d)
r_phi(x, y) = w_r^T * h_{|x|+|y|} [Evaluated at final <eos> token]
Pros: Simple pairwise training on (x, y_w, y_l) human/edit pairs.
Cons: Sparse terminal credit assignment across 8-step tool trajectories.
2. Process Reward Model (PRM): Step-Level Credit Assignment
Trajectory: [Step 1: Search] <sep> [Step 2: Filter] <sep> [Step 3: Synth]
p_phi(z_k = 1 | x, s_{<=k}) = sigma(w_prm^T * h_{sep_k}) per step k
Step labels z_k in {0, 1} generated automatically via Monte Carlo prefix
rollouts (Math-Shepherd / counterfactual bisection).
Trajectory aggregation: R_PRM(tau) = prod_{k=1}^K p_phi(z_k=1 | s_{<=k})
3. Stabilized Bradley-Terry Objective (Margin + Zero-Mean Center)
L_RM = -E[ log sigma(r_phi(x,y_w) - r_phi(x,y_l) - m(y_w,y_l)) ]
+ lambda_center * E[ (r_phi(x,y_w) + r_phi(x,y_l))^2 ]
- Margin m in {0.5, 1.5, 3.0}: Forces wider score gap on factual/safety
fixes (m=3.0) than minor stylistic rewrites (m=0.5).
- Centering penalty: Removes shift invariance (r + c) so reward
distribution stays centered at 0 across diverse prompts.
B. Defending Against Reward Hacking (Goodhart's Law)
The Overoptimization Trap at High KL Divergence D_KL(pi || pi_ref)
As RL policy or Best-of-N pushes far from pi_ref, single proxy RM r_phi
is fooled by 4 classic surface exploits:
1. Verbosity / Markdown List Padding (r_phi correlates with |y|)
2. Sycophancy (agreeing with false user premises)
3. Plausible Unverified Numbers ($79 vs $84) in OOD tail
Production 3-Wall Anti-Hacking Architecture
Wall 1: Multiplicative Deterministic Verifier Gate
If DeterministicVerifier(x, y) == FAIL -> R_total = -5.0 (Hard Floor)
Blocks schema errors, hallucinated SKUs, and SQL tenant leaks instantly.
Wall 2: K=3 Shared-Backbone LoRA RM Ensemble (LCB Penalty)
r_LCB(x, y) = mean_{k=1..3}(r_k) - eta * std_{k=1..3}(r_k)
OOD adversarial strings trigger high epistemic disagreement std(r_k),
automatically penalizing uncertain proxy peaks! (+0.4% VRAM overhead)
Wall 3: OLS Length Residualization & Excess-Token Penalty
r_clean(x, y) = r_LCB(x, y) - beta_len * log(|y|) - gamma * max(0, |y|-L_0)
Forces Corr(r_clean, |y|) = 0.00 on held-out calibration set.
